sql:
SELECT
  request_type,
  received_at,
  due_at,
  updated_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - received_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_received_to_updated_at,
  (updated_at <= due_at) AS within_due_at
FROM data_subject_requests
WHERE status = 'rejected'
  AND completed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY received_at ASC
note: Used data_subject_requests.updated_at only (no change_history/audit_log) as a proxy for "last touched" — this assumes nothing else modified these rows after the rejection decision, which is not verified by the data. days_received_to_updated_at is a fractional day count (updated_at - received_at in days).
